headline: Public Works Commission Recommends Denial of Kula Park Renaming

meeting.body: Public Works Commission Recommends Denial of Kula Park Renaming
meeting.summary: The Public Works Commission voted to recommend against renaming Kula Park and got training on open meeting and ethics rules.
meeting.recap: The Public Works Commission met on August 26, 2026, at 1:36 p.m.[[0:00:32]] A commissioner nominated himself for vice chair, and members held a vote.[[0:04:33]] The commission heard an application to rename Kula Park after a person.[[0:06:02]] One testifier asked the commission to wait until after the election.[[0:07:52]] A family member said the family supports the renaming.[[0:14:51]] Another testifier said the park should keep the name Kula Park.[[0:18:44]] A council member asked the commission to move the renaming forward.[[0:30:06]] Members were told they have 60 days to make a recommendation.[[0:37:58]] The County Council may adopt, change, or reject the commission's recommendation.[[0:41:38]] One commissioner said a new name would cost taxpayer money.[[0:42:18]] A motion to defer, or delay, the item was withdrawn after legal advice.[[0:44:12]] The chair said the commission has until October 7th to act.[[0:47:05]] One commissioner voted no, saying the honoree should be honored in some way.[[0:49:03]] The motion to recommend against the name change passed with five votes.[[0:49:34]] Staff said the commission gives advice to the mayor, council and public works director.[[0:52:40]] Members got training on the state's open meeting law, called the Sunshine Law.[[0:58:45]] The training also covered county ethics rules.[[1:10:40]]
decided: Members accepted the minutes from the last meeting by voice vote.
Members voted on a commissioner's self-nomination for vice chair, with no count stated.
meeting.next: Park renamings also go to the Cultural Resources Commission before the council. The council member said the renaming will go to the Maui County Council for a final vote. The council would have to pass any name change by ordinance, a county law.

moments.q: "I believe it should be kept as a name Kula Park in perpetuity."
Roll call vote on the renaming recommendation
